graph.title: The Big Bang Theory (LEGO Ideas 21302)

new_part_types.name: Whiteboard panel tile 4x4 with studs (white, printed)
Minifig head (Raj, element ID not legible)

notes: Heavily approximated: the instructions are pictures. Each wall, bookcase and furniture piece is listed with an Element ID taken from the inventory pages, but exact stud-to-stud adjacency inside the tan walls, the brick-texture wall and the minifig seating could not be read exactly.

Wall brick courses are stacked as repeats attached to a single anchor brick (b20, b21, b22, b34, b77, b78, b38, b79, b29, b116). Real layout is a layered wall; copy counts were adjusted so each Element ID matches the inventory count.

Many Element IDs were inferred from the small inventory thumbnails (e.g. 4211242 'dark brown brick with hole', 4620075/4225469 dark brown 1x1 bricks, 4579260 'tan 1x1 brick', 4160483 'tan grooved plate', 6016172 'rocket fins', 4604304 'laptop hinge'); names are best guesses. Some small shelf items (book stacks, the step-20 shelf stack) are only partly modelled, so a few 1x1 plates are attached to the nearest shelf piece.
Printed stickers (door poster, whiteboard writing, post outlets) are not physical pieces and are omitted.
Raj's head: only six head Element IDs are legible in the inventory; Raj's head is modelled as type lego-head-raj with no Element ID. Raj and Sheldon legs are both 4524098 (2x).

Minifigure neck/hip/hair ports are modelled as pin/pin-hole and stud/anti-stud so they join compatibly with the catalogue leg pieces (hip = stud, torso hip = anti-stud). Minifigures are shown seated or standing via 'contact/rest' edges (Leonard, Sheldon, Penny on the sofa; Howard on the ottoman; Raj in the armchair; Amy and Bernadette standing). The dog is on the floor.
The orange food items (2x on the parts box) are the 6037895 orange accessory cluster, modelled as one node resting on the table top; the mug, takeout boxes and newspaper sit on the round table top.

The whiteboard easel and the black shopping cart are free-standing mini-models beside the room (see cover); they are not fastened to the room. They are linked with 'contact' edges (easel foot to baseplate b1, cart cone to baseplate b7) so the graph is one connected build.

The booklet's black cart has a handle piece that could not be matched to a single inventory element; the cart is modelled with its 4 brackets, 4 cones, 2 ribbed plates and 3 plates, and its handle piece is omitted (4604304 is used once, for the laptop hinge).
Round black 1x1 plates (door handle, shelf bases, telescope/lamp bases) use element 614126 (5x on parts page). The blue 1x1 plate on the shelf is drawn as 4184108 (colour approximated).
